name: edgar_filing_details
description:
Details and document links for one SEC filing, identified by company CIK and accession number, from SEC EDGAR.
Returns {cik, accessionNumber, form, filingDate, reportDate, acceptanceDateTime, primaryDocument, primaryDocDescription, document_url (SEC viewer), filing_url (the primary document in the EDGAR archive)}.
Inputs (* required): cik* (string, SEC Central Index Key, up to 10 digits; from edgar_company_search), accession_number* (string, with or without dashes, e.g. 0000320193-23-000106).
An accession number outside the recent-filings block gives 'Filing not found'. Accession numbers come from edgar_filings_by_form and the other filing-list tools.
Example: {"cik": "0000320193", "accession_number": "0000320193-23-000106"}
No API key needed (SEC data.sec.gov; 110 ms between requests).
